description: This file contains unit tests for the FilterUtil class within the OpenMRS framework, specifically testing locale storage and restoration functionalities.

classes.name: FilterUtilTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the methods of FilterUtil related to locale management.

methods.name: storeLocale_shouldStoreLocale
methods.description: Tests that the storeLocale method correctly stores a locale.

methods.name: storeLocale_shouldRestoreLocale
methods.description: Tests that the restoreLocale method correctly retrieves the stored locale.

methods.name: storeLocale_shouldNotChangeStoredValueWhenStoringSameLocale
methods.description: Verifies that storing the same locale multiple times does not alter the stored value.

methods.name: storeLocale_shouldNotUpdateStoredValueWhenStoringDifferentLocale
methods.description: Checks that storing a different locale updates the stored value accordingly.
